faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT BHU is 14th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a First Class B.Tech/B.E. in Civil/Environmental/Chemical Engineering and M.Tech/M.E. in Environmental Engineering/Chemical Engineering/Environmental Sciences with a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 30 years, with relaxations applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT BHU primarily involves an Interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT BHU.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Applications for the Junior Research Fellow position must be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section provided in this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
